findings.description: Before stirring the bowl holds roughly 3 yellow, 3 green and 3-4 red balls (clear at 01.00 and 04.50). By 09.25 no yellow ball is visible and ~4-5 red and ~4 green appear; at 09.50 about 5-6 red, 1 yellow and 1 green are visible. Yellow balls vanish and red balls multiply without any ball being added or removed from the bowl.

During stirring the hard glossy spheres become lumpy, squashed and blob-like (e.g. irregular yellow lumps at 06.00, misshapen red/green blobs at 08.50-09.75, green ball melting into adjacent shapes at 09.25) in ways beyond motion blur; rigid plastic balls should stay spherical.
The stirring right hand smears and merges with the balls; at 09.00-09.25 fingers are indistinct and appear to blend into ball shapes, giving an implausible hand-object merge.
